channel.title: Raspberry-Pi-Pico on Coding With Matt
channel.description: Recent content in Raspberry-Pi-Pico on Coding With Matt

item.title: Phase 5: Drawing Graphics — Shapes, Scenes, and Animation
item.description: Build a scene from simple drawing commands, then explore motion, trails, screen boundaries, and timing in a frame-by-frame animation lab.

item.title: Phase 4: The Frame Buffer — Draw First, Show Second
item.description: Draw in an interactive frame buffer, then trace text(), fill(), and show() from Pico RAM to the OLED.

item.title: Phase 3: Memory Organization — Pages, Bytes, and Coordinates
item.description: Trace a pixel from (x, y) to its page, byte, and bit in SSD1306 display memory.

item.title: Phase 2: Pictures as Data — Binary, Hex, and Bit Masks
item.description: Move from OLED pixels to bytes, binary, hexadecimal, shifts, and masks—then practice the connections in an interactive byte-building game.

item.title: Phase 1: Meet the OLED — Pixels, Coordinates, and show()
item.description: Use a Pico and SSD1306 OLED to learn I2C wiring, screen coordinates, drawing commands, and the frame buffer behind show().

item.title: Start Here: The Raspberry Pi Pico OLED Project
item.description: Start the Pico OLED series: explore the ten-phase roadmap, find each published lesson, and see why rebuilding a small driver helps the ideas connect.
